effect: Charging the battery completed the night-preparation goal and revealed that a supplied fuel-cell backup can sustain essential systems through a dark spell.
reaction: The connection back to the recovered array was satisfying, though the fuel-cell backup was new information.

mostWorthwhile.text: Restoring the radio was most worthwhile: Mara’s twelve-minute-old message made the distance from Earth tangible and opened a thread I wanted to follow.

leastWorthwhile.text: Straightening the antenna was a predictable repair with little detail, although it made sense as preparation for mounting it.

surprise.text: I was surprised to learn that the cabin has a supplied fuel-cell backup for essential systems during a dark spell.

arbitrary.text: None of the actions felt arbitrary; the antenna, window quilt, and battery each had a clear connection to the goals.

continue.text: Yes. I would continue to hear Mara’s reply and see how the expedition develops, especially after the radio made the communication delay feel real.
